nuggets.text: Quarterback DJ Lagway transferred from Florida to Baylor, where his father, Derek Lagway, once played.
DJ Lagway is the highest-rated recruit ever to play for Baylor.
DJ Lagway threw for 333 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears' 17-16 opener against Auburn in Atlanta.
Baylor's first live bear mascot was won in a poker game from a soldier stationed at Waco's Camp MacArthur.
Baylor did not adopt the Bears as its mascot until December 14, 1914.
McLane Stadium sits on the Brazos River, so Bears fans can arrive by boat and go 'sailgating.'
The Bears' home locker room at McLane Stadium is an oval shaped like a football.
Before each game, Baylor freshmen in the Baylor Line dash down the field to form a human tunnel for the team.
Robert Griffin III became the first Baylor player to win the Heisman Trophy, in 2011.
Bears coach Dave Aranda coached Cal Lutheran's linebackers while still an undergraduate there.
